description: This file contains automated test scripts for login functionality using Playwright. It defines multiple test cases to verify login, preview, menu validation, and error handling on a web application's login page.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Represents the login page object model encapsulating actions like navigating, logging in, and verifying UI elements.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with provided username and password.

methods.name: clickPreview
methods.description: Clicks the preview button inside the builder.

methods.name: expectPreviewContainsTimesAndHeading
methods.description: Validates the content inside the preview for specific times and headings.

methods.name: expectBuilderMenus
methods.description: Validates the presence of builder menu options.

methods.name: expectAuthError
methods.description: Checks for expected authentication error messages.
